title: Bank Deposit Funding Collection, Rate Lock and Re-Quotes
content:
On Bank Deposit, card and pay-by-bank payments are collected at booking; an ACH debit is collected when it settles; a wire is collected when it arrives. The quoted exchange rate is guaranteed for the tier's rate-lock hours, counted as elapsed hours from the booking moment.

## Rate lock and re-quote

- A rate is re-quoted only when funds are collected more than the tier's rate-lock hours after the transfer was booked.
- Lock hours are counted as elapsed hours from the booking moment to the moment the funds are collected.
- Funds collected at exactly the end of the lock are not more than the lock hours after booking, so the quoted rate stands.
- A re-quote uses the Paloma rate sheet for the collection date with the same margin rule as at booking. It re-discloses the exchange rate, the amount the recipient receives and the date of availability, and it never changes the fees.

| Hypothetical case (tier with a 48-hour lock) | Elapsed hours from booking to collection | Re-quoted? |
|---|---|---|
| ACH debit settles | 47.5 | no |
| ACH debit settles | 48.0 | no (exactly the lock) |
| ACH debit settles | 48.1 | yes |

## Wire funding deadline

- On a tier whose wire funding deadline is above 0, Paloma cancels a wire-funded booking only when the funds have not arrived more than the deadline's hours after the transfer was booked.
- The funding deadline is counted in elapsed hours from the booking moment to the handling moment.
- At exactly the deadline the booking is not yet cancelled; it is cancelled only once more than the deadline's hours have elapsed without the wire.

| Hypothetical case (tier with a 48-hour deadline) | Elapsed hours, wire not arrived | Cancelled by Paloma? |
|---|---|---|
| Handling moment | 48.0 | no |
| Handling moment | 49.0 | yes |

## Failed funding

When an ACH debit is returned unpaid before release, or a card capture fails, Paloma cancels the transfer with the hold reason recorded as failed funding. A cancellation for missing or failed funding owes nothing back, because nothing was collected, and the transfer stays cancelled as its final status.
